text:
michael_collections: Heads-up: Skylark Labs (SKY-3309) has invoice 3309 for $12,300 overdue since 2026-03-05. They emailed asking for a one-time extension to avoid suspension; say they can pay by 2026-04-10. Thoughts? @tara_fin @ravi_sales

billing-bot: Automated: invoice 3309 marked past_due as of 2026-03-06; 2 retries failed.

tara_fin: For small mid-market accounts like this, we usually allow a 30-day extension with no fee once per fiscal year. Check if they've used the grace before.

ravi_sales: Skylark is on startup discount and had a credits hold last year. Sales prefers to protect the relationship; extension ok but require card on file update and reminder notifications. If they miss, product access suspends.

ida-cs: CS convo says they had payroll timing issues, will wire by 4/10 and provided an email confirmation from their finance lead.

michael_collections: I pulled account ledger: no prior grace used in last 12 months. Proposed approach: allow one-time 30-day extension to 2026-04-04 (30 days from due) or to 4/10 as they requested? We should be consistent. Also propose requiring card-on-file + automatic retry.

tara_fin: Approve extension to 2026-04-04. Tell them to update card on file or provide wire proof by that date. If not received, suspend on 2026-04-05 and start escalations.

michael_collections: Noted. I'll send extension confirmation and update the billing portal. Also scheduling a follow-up on 4/05.

billing-bot: Reminder: extension granted until 2026-04-04 for invoice 3309. Next action: suspend on 2026-04-05 if not paid.

ravi_sales: I'll nudge their finance lead to prioritize. Can we add a note to pause onboarding until payment is posted?

legal-ops: No legal involvement needed for standard 30-day extension. Keep records of the communication in the contract folder.

michael_collections: Customer updated card today and set up autopay. They still said they'll wire if autopay fails. Moving to "watchlist" rather than escalation.

billing-bot: Payment monitor: card charge $12,300 attempted 2026-04-03 02:15 UTC  success. Invoice 3309 marked paid. :tada:

michael_collections: Paid and closed. Leaving note: granted one-time 30-day extension per policy. Closing thread.
